Larry spends half an hour twice a day walking and playing with his dog. He also spends a fifth of an hour every day feeding his dog. How many minutes does Larry spend on his dog each day?

Given:
- Larry spends half an hour twice a day walking his dog.
- He also spends a fifth of an hour every day feeding his dog.

First, calculate the total time Larry spends walking his dog each day:
- Half an hour is 30 minutes.
- He walks his dog twice a day, so \(30 \text{ minutes} \times 2 = 60 \text{ minutes}\).

Next, calculate the time Larry spends feeding his dog each day:
- A fifth of an hour is \( \frac{60 \text{ minutes}}{5} = 12 \text{ minutes}\).

Now, add the time spent walking and feeding his dog:
- Total time = time walking + time feeding = \(60 \text{ minutes} + 12 \text{ minutes} = 72 \text{ minutes}\).

FINAL: 72
